research_question: Can entity-state-first generation produce better Brand3 findings than the current dimension-by-dimension pipeline without inventing coherence or hiding uncertainty?

existing_trials.main_learning: State-first helps when related surfaces must not be collapsed into one platform story.
State-first helps prevent similarly named surfaces from becoming false aliases or brand architecture.
State-first can stay light when the entity is stable; overstructuring would be a failure.

success_signals: entity ambiguity becomes explicit and review-gated
owned claims and external signals are separated
missing evidence URLs are handled as a limitation rather than repeated caveats
failure_signals: Kit and BuiltWith are treated as one entity without proof
caveats are hidden instead of governed

success_signals: fallback openings are not repeated per finding
weak evidence is named once at the right level
failure_signals: strategic depth is manufactured from thin evidence
baseline remains equally good because there is not enough signal

recommended_next_action.goal_title: Run State-First Generation Trials For Builtwith, Netlify, And One High-Evidence Control
notes: Use Supabase or Temporal as the high-evidence control.
If neither has an existing reliable Brand3 run, create audit artifacts first and stop before generation.
Continue the phase only if hard cases improve while healthy cases stay light, or if failure clearly defines what should not be automated.
